name: Lead (fcc)
notes: The fcc cell is calculated from the 300 K reference volume of the PVT EoS. PhaseSmith calculates powder reflections and intensities from the ideal structure.

eos_records.label: Fortes (2019), 300 K BM4 slice

reference.source: STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory Technical Report RAL-TR-2019-002

eos_records.notes: Static 300 K slice of the report's temperature-dependent BM4 pressure-marker model. V0(T) and K0(T) were constrained first from thermal-expansion and elastic data; K0_prime and K0_double_prime were then fitted to compression data spanning 295-788 K. The polynomial temperature dependence is intentionally not stored because the current thermal schema cannot represent it. Primary report: https://epubs.stfc.ac.uk/manifestation/40740885/RAL-TR-2019-002.pdf
